Oh my gosh?! I-I thought you guys were human!\nWhat are you?!
Kunst.
Menberg.
Harstel.
What?
We were presented with a question about ourselves,\nso we just answered with our names.
That's not what I mean! What I wanna know is what\nkind of creature you are because you look like\nhuman but you're in the weredragon's world!!
We're the remaining homunculi at the lower part of\nEldenbaum. We've been living here since we fell\nonto this rock mass when the Cataclysm happened.
Homunculi...Ah, those we saw in Eldenbaum...\nWait, if that's true, then how long have you guys\nbeen alive?!
Why are guys still alive in the first place tho?\nI mean I've seen your relatives in the upper part\nof Eldenbaum before, but they were just bones!
We have no idea either. The other homunculi who\nfell here with us had stopped functioning for\nquite some time...
This is just our personal opinion, but the fact\nthat we are still functioning until now means...
There is still something that should be done by\nus...That's what we've been telling ourselves all\nthis time...
In fact, what we've learned can be put to use\nhere...
Umm...It seems like they've been through a lot,\ndon't you wanna know more about them?
You'd better not.\nThese creatures talk a lot.
Where did you learn your skills?
You can put your skills to use here?
What are you doing here?
I have no questions.
After Homunculi were allowed to live in the upper\npart of Eldenbaum, we met the head of the Lufenas\nfamily at that time and we learned various skills.
The Lufenas...Oh, Triet's family. And the head of\nthe family at that time...Was it the creator of\nthe teleporter? His magic skills were amazing...
When we fell here, we realized that the rock mass\nwas floating and moving...
Back then it kept colliding with other rock and\nlandmasses, and we believed that it would crumble\nif we didn't do anything...
So we thought if we could use what we've learned\nin the world we came from to create a system that\ncontrols its movement speed and direction,
and stops it from colliding with other rock and\nlandmasses, we would be able to save many lives\nhere...
I see, so that's what you meant when you said you\ncould put what you'd learned to use here...
With the help of the weredragons who fell here at\nthe same time as us, we succeeded in building a\npropulsion system through the combination of
our Elven master's magic art and the Slebinian\nmechanical technology we learned prior to the\nCataclysm...
To move this huge rock mass safely, there is a\nneed to control its movement direction and\nstabilize the propulsion system.
That's why we're here to maintain it and adjust\nthe steering mechanism in the cockpit.
Asking about the vital point of the weredragons...
We know it's floating in the sky and it's a sacred\nplace for the weredragons, but we've never been\nthere as there's no reason for us to go there.
I heard Boontam, the weredragon in the cockpit,\nused to pilot an airship and fly to various\nplaces, so he might know how to get there.
We were actually gonna ask Uncle Boontam about the\nvital point of the weredragons. Let's go see him!
I hope the operation to move the rock mass is\nsmooth...Because that old man is scary if you talk\nto him while he's doing his job in bad weather...
Oh! It's you Zianga! What's up?
Oh, I've got something to check with you.\nBut, you're steering the rock mass, aren't you?
Yeah, but you came at the right time.\nSome pesky problems just happened.
Dragons?! Why are there dragons here?!
I dunno, they just appeared out of nowhere, and it\nseems like they're coming in from the back area.\nI was about to go ask for help.
I thought those dragons don't know about this\nplace. How did they find out?!
That's what I thought too, but...As you can see,\nthey're prolly heading to the cockpit, would you\nhelp me fight them?
Leave it to me! Just in case, I want you to go\ncall for backup!!
Got it!!
Sorry, but we're gonna head to the cockpit while\nbeating those creatures! C'mon, help me!!
And you two, I want you to follow us carefully,\ndon't get hurt and don't get left behind, got it?!
So they got in from here?! I suppose this place\nisn't visible from the outside, I wonder what\nthey are after...
Stop talking, we're getting more and more of them\nhere, you know!
Let's just beat as many as we can and we keep\ngoing!!
Yeah, I know! We're going straight to the\ncockpit!!
Okay!
